meta.title: Magpie Dashboards
meta.subtitle: Product leadership through rebuild, recovery, and scale

items.name: Infra: New Data Lake Layers Marts, Analytics, Staging, Prod
items.description: Built the V2 data lake foundation: layered marts, analytics, staging, and prod environments with dbt.
items.value: Replaced a monolithic, fragmented ETL with a version-controlled, testable, observable architecture that can scale to K-8 and projected user growth.

relations.description: provided the pipeline Completion re-launched on.

items.description: Workstream shoring up prior-year promises: bug fixes, small enhancements, and unblocked commitments.
items.value: Restored credibility with partners on existing commitments while the V2 rebuild proceeded in parallel.

items.name: Data Lineage data dictionary for UI and DBT documentation for Data Lake

items.name: Quality & Testing Improvements to V1 ETL and some V2
items.description: Testing epic hardening the legacy V1 pipeline (and early V2) while V2 was under construction.
items.value: Kept the live product reliable during the migration; customers never lost the nightly refresh.

protected V1 stability while the first migration ran.

items.name: V2 Migration Phases 1/3 Completion Dashboard
items.description: The Completion Dashboard blackout and rebuild: taken offline deliberately, rebuilt on the V2 pipeline, relaunched with V1/V2 parity validation.
items.value: Relaunched with zero reported bugs and became the proof-of-concept migration model, so Usage and ROAR migrate without blackouts.

relations.targetName: Infra: New Data Lake Layers Marts, Analytics, Staging, Prod

items.name: SLI/SLO [refined] ability, definitions, and creation
items.description: Defined and created service level indicators and objectives for the dashboards and backend, where none existed.
items.value: Gave the team measurable reliability targets, enabling alerting, enablement claims, and go-to-market confidence.

relations.description: direct output; the SLI/SLOs are what the alerts measure (explicit arrow in source diagram).
shares the DataDog instrumentation foundation.

items.name: DataDog Reports & Alerts
items.description: Reports and alerting built on the SLI/SLO definitions and DataDog instrumentation.
items.value: The team now detects degradation before customers report it; stability became observable rather than assumed.

relations.description: implements those definitions (explicit arrow in source diagram).

items.name: Expanded Student Analytics
items.description: Expanded educator-facing analytics to show individual student performance against peers.
items.value: Gave educators the context to interpret an individual student's numbers, deepening the dashboards' instructional value.

items.description: Test automation and expanded synthetic and edge-case data for the V2 pipeline.

items.name: ROAR Phoneme Rework
items.description: Scoring change from percentile to % Correct after Stanford deprecated the norming tables, shipped against a hard back-to-school deadline.
items.value: Preserved assessment scoring for educators despite a vanished external dependency; a deliberate scope cut (reusing the Letter pattern) reduced the work by roughly a third and protected the deadline.

items.value: Extends the product to the company's new market; aggregation suppression for grades 3-8 treated as load-bearing correctness work ahead of August rostering.

items.name: App Usage Visibility Report build
items.description: Usage reports built by Rico on DataDog instrumentation engineering stood up, showing how educators actually use the dashboards.
items.value: Ended flying blind: the team could finally see customer behavior, which fed adoption insight, instrumentation gap findings, and the fidelity problem discovery.

relations.description: the analysis performed on these reports.
shares the DataDog foundation.
usage findings (low fidelity of use) motivated the series.

items.name: A11y scraper
items.description: WCAG 2.2 accessibility scanner built by Rico to check dashboard pages for compliance.
items.value: Established accessibility parity with the student side as a measurable, repeatable check; a11y is woven incrementally into UI work rather than run as one initiative.

relations.description: the incremental a11y program began with the Completion relaunch.

items.name: Replica Site
items.description: Exact, data-rich copy of the dashboard UI and functionality (six months of data, design schema parity) built by Rico.
items.value: Prototyping and design environment that covers the committed-designer gap; used to produce research and product feature designs without engineering time.

relations.description: the environment those designs are produced in.
prototypes validated with customers came from here.

items.description: Manual production reporting covering ROAR Phoneme scoring and stuck-student detection during the dashboard coverage gap.

items.description: Analysis of the usage reports: adoption patterns, instrumentation gaps, and behavioral findings.

items.description: Structured experiment testing whether the frontend could be served directly from the data lake; failed on cost and performance.
items.value: Because it was framed as an experiment, the failure was cheap and decisive; it drove the shipped architecture (transform in the lake, serve from Postgres).
